**Problem:** For single-targeting projects (all projects in this repo), `$(TargetFramework)` is **empty** during `.props` evaluation.   <Authors>Build Team</Authors>

  <Company Condition="'$(Company)' == ''">Contoso</Company>
  <Authors Condition="'$(Authors)' == ''">Build Team</Authors>
